# Aarti Sri Ravikumar — Evidence-Led Student Resilience Research

> A student research portfolio about Aether, a privacy-aware framework for student resilience grounded in academic research, school connectedness, reflective expression, human support, and kindness.

## Primary Pages

- / — Homepage with research thesis, evidence ledger, Aether pathway, profile, journal, and reviewer FAQ
- /aether-student-resiliency-framework-2026.pdf — Student-authored Aether proposal PDF
- /blog — Field notes on research, writing, engineering, and portfolio development
- /support-center — Contact, collaboration, and support pathway
- /testimony — Portfolio journey and milestone context
- /web3-proof — Optional Web3-style identity proof page
- /privacy-policy — Privacy commitments
- /terms-of-service — Usage terms

## Core Topics

- Aarti Sri Ravikumar, student researcher and systems builder
- Aether: The Student Resiliency Ecosystem
- Evidence-led kindness and student resilience
- School connectedness, belonging, and social support
- Expressive reflection and student voice
- Privacy-aware AI, human handoff, and responsible boundaries
- Clear writing, implementation discipline, and public academic communication

## Evidence Sources Referenced

- CDC adolescent mental health data: https://www.cdc.gov/healthy-youth/mental-health/index.html
- CDC school connectedness guidance: https://www.cdc.gov/youth-behavior/school-connectedness/index.html
- U.S. Surgeon General advisory on social connection: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK595227/
- Pennebaker expressive writing research: https://doi.org/10.1111/j.1467-9280.1997.tb00403.x
- Digital resilience interventions review: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41746-024-01017-8

## Safety Boundary

This site is educational research and project documentation. It is not medical advice, therapy, diagnosis, emergency care, or a crisis service. In the United States, people in immediate crisis can call or text 988 or contact local emergency services.
